messages.content: I can't log in — it says my password is wrong but I just changed it yesterday.
Sorry for the trouble! A password change can take a few minutes to sync. First, make sure Caps Lock is off and try again. If it still fails, I can send a fresh reset link — shall I?
Done — a reset link is on its way to your email (valid for 30 minutes). If it doesn't arrive within 2 minutes, check spam or let me know and I'll verify the address on file.
Got it, I'm in now. Thanks!
You're welcome! For security, consider enabling two-factor authentication in Settings → Security. Anything else I can help with?
